as_told.title: Fast walkers: leaked Podesta–Bob Fish email

plain: Michels says that "fast walkers", a term for unidentified objects tracked by satellites as they move quickly through space, came up in an email between the political adviser John Podesta and a contractor named Bob Fish, part of the Podesta emails WikiLeaks released in 2016. Michels brings this up himself across several episodes and describes it a little differently each time. He calls Fish an aerospace contractor who may have worked at the Aerospace Corporation in El Segundo, then once an IT contractor. Once he dates the email loosely to the 2010s. He also mentions geostationary orbit and credits the records researcher John Greenewald Jr. If true, it would mean the subject reached a senior political figure.
